summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on the status of the built-in ClickHouse cache. [p1] noted that security calculations rely on the presence of this cache (specifically for `user_access` queries). [me] stated they would enable the internal CH cache on production, noting it was previously set to false by default and thus not working in the live environment.

[p1] confirmed seeing the cache enabled on production previously. The conversation concluded with a decision to activate the cache using a single variable switch, which [p1] believes will simplify access for users and is reversible if necessary.
decisions: The built-in ClickHouse cache will be enabled on production.
action_items: [me] to enable the internal CH cache on production.
